title: Concept: Remote download from a runtime URL in csharp — review required
description: In csharp, a download helper is called with a runtime address. WebClient follows redirects and accepts every scheme the underlying stack supports, so validation performed after the call cannot undo the request. The pattern is common in integration code that forwards a caller-supplied URL.
applicability: csharp services that fetch remote resources.
risk: Server-side request forgery against internal services; MEDIUM severity.
